hypotheses.reasoning: notification-svc heap grows without being reclaimed: old gen not reclaimed after full GC at 20:49:18 (#1719, heap 78%), worsening to 87% with GC overhead 35% at 20:52:45 (#2171). It then hits OutOfMemoryError in messageCache.put (#2250) and is OOMKilled at its 2Gi limit (#2253, #2482, #2647), repeatedly restarting. Each restart leaves notification-svc with no healthy upstream, so api-gateway returns 502 'connection reset (no healthy upstream)' on POST /v1/notify (#2362, #2411, #2556, #2656). The messageCache appears unbounded (leak). The 502 bursts match the OOM restart cycles. Ruled out: the search-api/catalog-svc 401 translation errors (#2300, #2383) are a separate fault that only affects /search; the legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts are noise; the template-svc slow render (#1118) is a soft warning, not the 502 source. No deploy line was found.

Alternative reading: the slow template-svc render (#1118) and gateway retry/connection churn could amplify load on notification-svc. Evidence is weak; the OOM lines show the origin is the heap, not retries.

verdict.recommendedAction: Heap-dump notification-svc to find the unbounded messageCache growth, add eviction/size limits, and restart the pods as a stopgap. Raise the memory limit only as a temporary measure. Open a separate ticket for the catalog-svc translation API 401 (invalid key), which breaks /search but is not the cause of the notify 502s.
